the machined chips range in size from 80–500 μm (Fig. 1(a))
Machined chips of the alloy were canned in a Cu tube, followed by evacuating, and then sealing.
The sealed machined chips were extruded at an extrusion ratio of 10 at 623 K.

the extruded Mg96Zn2Y2 alloy processed at 623 K shows bright contrast due to compound phases in the Mg matrix with about 10–40 μm thickness (Fig. 1(b)). The area fraction of the compound phases in this image is about 41%.
Although a few cavities of less than 5 μm are observed in the Mg matrix, individual machined chips and visible cracks are not clearly observed in the extruded alloy.
